ask: Is this the right shape for the key word page?
problem: Teams should not have to enter key words before a book. They add them as passages need them. Each way of saying a word should show where it is used.
found: The page had a long explanation and no link from a way to its passages. Passages were not tied to any way.
changed: No explanation text. Each way lists its passages as large rows. Tap one to open that version in context. A way records which passage you were on. Words can be added any time.
why: A clip now remembers the passage being drafted, so no extra step is needed. Pictures are drawings in app colours, not screenshots; no live app runs here. Database checks must pass in the pull request.
touches: A new database migration. 15 translations I wrote need a native reader. Phones download the new clips. Play store answers stay the same.

pictures.label: Before: Amina ties the word by hand
After: ways, clips, and passages to tap
Tap a passage to hear it in context
Add words any time, not before the book

guess.change: Show the ways and their passages in the recording screen's key words pane too
